answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in lantern and delta lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the wharf graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 780 impostors cost 880 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
